source.kind: exact local Codex demo chat rollout

scope: Exact user-visible demo prompts and all completed CARLA execute_carla_script calls through the recorded cutoff. Hidden reasoning, system/developer instructions, non-CARLA tools, other chats, local absolute paths and image bytes are excluded.
prompt_provenance: Prompts were submitted to the real Codex demo chat by the owner-authorized recording orchestrator; this does not assert manual keyboard typing.
publication_status: Machine-readable evidence verified; final video export checks are recorded separately.
editing_disclosure: This receipt covers the separate fresh scene take. Earlier rehearsal attempts and failures are retained in evidence-chat.json. The video is an edited selection; export timing and playback rates are recorded separately.
interpretation_notes: No Jev requests are made by these CARLA scripts.
The named car and simulator endpoint were prepared before this take; full setup instructions are retained in the exact initial prompt.
Successful finite calls intentionally retain the vehicle; final removal is recorded in evidence-cleanup.json and independently verified in final-world-state.json.
The exact capture-time prompt preserves the basename-path workaround; subsequent code changes do not rewrite this historical request.

prompts.text:
Show me front and chase camera views from demo-car.

Prepared recording setup: use the CARLA MCP execute_carla_script tool at host127.0.0.1 port3200, CARLA0.10.0. Existing named actor demo-car is parked. Keep it parked and world asynchronous; use api.describe_api() if discovery needed, never dir(api). Use two separate MCP calls, each attaching one RGB camera, capturing a published640x360 image, then detaching it in finally. Use captures/demo-clean-front.png and captures/demo-clean-chase.png; basename-only paths currently fail. A single640x360image fits512KiB per-image and1MiBtotal limits; two inonecallmayexceedtotal. Suggested relativefront(x1.7,y0,z1.5,pitch0), chase(x-8,y0,z3.5,pitch-14), fov90. Show actualMCPImageContent, describe what you see, and confirm no cameras remain. Do not editfiles, move the car, or useJev. Keep finalreplyconcise.

arguments.code:
car = api.resolve_actor('demo-car')
sensor = None
try:
    sensor = api.attach_sensor('sensor.camera.rgb', car['actor_id'], {'location': {'x': -8, 'y': 0, 'z': 3.5}, 'rotation': {'pitch': -14, 'yaw': 0, 'roll': 0}}, {'image_size_x': '640', 'image_size_y': '360', 'fov': '90'})
    result = {'view': 'chase', 'capture': api.capture_sensor_frame(sensor['sensor_id'], 'captures/demo-clean-chase.png', publish=True)}
finally:
    if sensor is not None and 'sensor_id' in sensor:
        detached = api.detach_sensor(sensor['sensor_id'])
api.wait(0.5)
result['detached'] = detached
result['cameras_remaining'] = api.list_actors('sensor.camera.*')
result['car'] = api.get_vehicle_telemetry(car['actor_id'])
result['world'] = api.get_world_state()

privacy_projection: Thread identifiers, local absolute paths, runner paths, raw stderr, hidden reasoning, system/developer instructions, credentials and embedded image bytes are excluded. Exact scene prompts, CARLA code/results, simulator actor IDs and image hashes are retained.
